execution_disposition.meaning: Execution and replay apparatus completed; expected public dispositions matched in 7/9 cases. This is not universal gate success or semantic qualification.

original_quote_review.interpretation_limit: These judgments identify support gaps in the exact supplied quotations; they do not establish that the fuller source contradicts the claims.
original_quote_review.review_scope: Only accepted claim text, its cited chunk IDs and quotes, and the question. No wider source context, rejected claims, TEST, PROSPECTIVE, or Wave B was inspected for this review.

preservation: selected original JSON values, not an exact-byte copy of receipt.json
